tasks.title: Compose setups receive a validated persistent console encryption key through secrets-init
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, Behavior: Host key, secrets-init files mode, secrets-init generate mode and Compose; corresponding Checks for init-secrets, check-setup rule 7, secrets-init and Compose config. Implement one coherent provisioning path: make_token creates console-secret-key without overwriting; strict host key validation and comparison with all tokens occurs before any files-mode write when /out/console exists; generate mode keeps a valid key and refuses an invalid existing key without replacing it. Preserve path/permission checks, atomic writes and no-secret output. Set PULSE_CONSOLE_SECRET_KEY_FILE=/run/pulse/secret-key in full/dev/demo with existing volumes, ports and dependencies. Update existing secrets-init console fixtures with valid distinct key inputs. Repository dependency console has merged before this child starts; the new dev console-setup flow is implemented in T3. Keep CLI unit checks green; CLI provisioning joins the shared helper in T2.

acceptance.expected: exit 0; host console-secret-key is a regular mode-600 file with 64 lowercase hex characters and one LF, created safely without secret output; second run preserves its SHA-256. Rule 7 covers key mode/content/preservation and the negative missing-key case fails with rule 7. Existing token, symlink and static-setup cases still pass.

exit 0; files mode writes /out/console/secret-key byte-equal to the host key minus one LF with ownership/mode 1000:1000 400. Missing/uppercase/token-equal keys fail with the three literal /in/console-secret-key errors and write zero output files; symlink/nonregular/group-or-other access is refused. Without /out/console no key is required. Generate mode creates 64 lowercase hex, preserves its SHA-256 on rerun, and an invalid existing key gives /out/console/secret-key: must hold 64 lowercase hex characters with the old bytes unchanged.

acceptance.expected: exit 0; full/dev/demo console environment names /run/pulse/secret-key using the existing console secrets volume; minimal, ports, depends_on and image pins are unchanged

tasks.title: CLI installs generate a console key and refuse to replace an invalid existing key
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, Behavior: CLI; all CLI Checks, including isSecretKeyContent, generation only when console is enabled, random draw after tokens/before installId, KNOWN_FILES, preflight with no writes on invalid key, --force byte preservation and rendered console env. Adapt deterministic comparison fixtures to the specified draw order. Keep valid-file, symlink, permission, lock and atomic-write protections; a valid existing key is preserved rather than treated as an ordinary replaceable token. No-console/minimal rendering remains unchanged. Shared secrets-init implementation is T1.

acceptance.command: bun test --coverage cli/tokens.test.ts cli/init.test.ts cli/write-install.test.ts cli/render-compose.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 fail in selected tests; focused coverage may exit nonzero. Console-enabled init writes secrets/console-secret-key matching ^[0-9a-f]{64}\n$ in mode 600 after drawing tokens and before installId; no-console init writes no key. --force preserves a valid key byte-for-byte and refuses an invalid key with secrets/console-secret-key: is not a valid key (64 lowercase hex characters); fix or remove it before any write. Strict content accepts no LF or one LF only; malformed cases from the spec fail. Rendered console env points to /run/pulse/secret-key; minimal without console remains byte-equal to the existing fixture.

acceptance.command: bun run lint && bun run typecheck
acceptance.expected: exit 0; CLI generation/writer/render integration and deterministic fixtures compile without changing shared config, package pins or secrets handling guarantees

tasks.title: Compose proves two-factor sign-in, recovery replay rejection and session revocation across restart
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, Behavior: e2e/totp.mjs and e2e/console-setup.sh steps 1-13; Acceptance evidence 12; all final Checks, Completion evidence and applicable Security impact checklist. Preserve separate cookie jars, Origin/CSRF order, no-secret output, bounded new-step waits and independent RFC helper self-check. The whole e2e algorithm stays in one task, including enrolment, ten codes, TOTP, recovery replay, sign out all, recreation with persisted key and the database/sidecar positive-control scan. Run the touched CI jobs' commands, CLI render/live-stack/build checks and the existing pinned-image compose e2e. Document strict key format, upgrade by rerunning init-secrets for existing full/dev installs, database+key backup and lost-key/recovery path, expected interim dev failure, and full/demo/CLI 2FA activation only after a later console image pin bump. Do not bump images or edit workflows outside the approved Files list.

acceptance.expected: exit 0; helper first checks the independent RFC 6238 Appendix B six-digit value 287082 for ASCII seed 12345678901234567890 at T=59; then prints only current integer step and a six-ASCII-digit code. Production algorithm is SHA-1, 30-second step, six digits; helper never prints its key.

acceptance.command: scripts/init-secrets.sh && docker compose -f dev/compose.yaml up -d --build && scripts/wait-ready.sh dev/compose.yaml 900 && bash e2e/console-setup.sh dev/compose.yaml
acceptance.expected: exit 0 on fresh console-data and sibling service main checkouts containing console #563; all steps 1-13 emit only nonsecret ok lines. Finish setup 303 /account/authenticator; enrolment gives 10 correctly formatted codes and GET / 200; password gives 303 /sign-in/factor; a fresh-step TOTP gives 303 then / 200. Recovery first use 303 and second use in jar D 401. Sign out all gives 303 /sign-in?signed-out=all and jar B next GET / gives 303 /sign-in?next=%2F. Recreate yields zero new setup-code lines, /setup 404 and TOTP 303 then / 200 with the same key. In every database/sidecar, key/base32 setup key/all ten recovery codes each have grep -a -c -F exit 1 and count 0; owner email is found at least once. The PR includes actual ok lines without secrets.
